text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Summer camp has once again<n>started, and this
camp will be a critical<n>part of our preparations for
our<n>showdown with Narita Brian.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I show Biwa Hayahide the data that<n>I've
meticulously prepared. There's<n>a vast amount of
notes, covering<n>everything from her next race to the
Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Seeing the volume of data, she<n>realizes the sheer
effort I used to<n>gather it all and begins worrying
about my health.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Our second summer camp will bring<n>us one step
closer to completing her<n>winning equation.
